mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint a house exterior in areas like Daly City or San Bruno?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to paint a house exterior in areas like Daly City or San Bruno depends on the size and complexity of the home, weather conditions, the amount of prep work required, and the size of the painting crew. A small to medium-sized home might take 3-7 days from start to finish, including preparation, drying times between coats, and cleanup. Larger homes, those with intricate architectural details, or those needing extensive repairs could take two weeks or more. Unfavorable weather, like rain or high humidity, can also extend the project timeline.
